fields.name: Customer_Residual_Rating__c
fields.label: Customer Residual Rating
fields.formula:
IF(ISPICKVAL(Type, "Customer: Enterprise"), 5,
IF( Total_MRR__c > 1835, 5,
IF( Total_MRR__c > 457, 4,
IF( Total_MRR__c > 216, 3,
IF( Total_MRR__c > 95, 2,
IF( Total_MRR__c > 1, 1, 0))))))

fields.name: Support_Contract_Status__c
fields.label: Support Contract Status
fields.formula:
IF(
AND(Billed_Under_Parent__c, NOT(ISBLANK(ParentId))),
IF(
  OR(
    AND(Parent.Fusebill2014__Fusebill_Customer_Account_Status__c = "PoorStanding", Parent.Fusebill2014__FusebillData_Status__c = "PoorStanding"),
    AND(Parent.Fusebill2014__Fusebill_Customer_Account_Status__c = "Good", Parent.Fusebill2014__FusebillData_Status__c = "Cancelled")
  ),
  IMAGE("/servlet/servlet.FileDownload?file=015PC000005kxDV", "Past Due"),
  IF(
    OR(
      AND(Parent.Fusebill2014__Fusebill_Customer_Account_Status__c = "Good", Parent.Fusebill2014__FusebillData_Status__c = "Active"),
      AND(Parent.Fusebill2014__Fusebill_Customer_Account_Status__c = "", ISPICKVAL(Parent.Account_Status__c, "Legacy: Paid Support"))
    ),
    IF(Parent.Customer_Residual_Rating__c < 4,
      IMAGE("/servlet/servlet.FileDownload?file=015PC000003CCwX", "Active Support"),
      IF(Parent.Customer_Residual_Rating__c > 3,
        IMAGE("/servlet/servlet.FileDownload?file=015PC000003CAt8", "VIP Support"),
        IMAGE("/servlet/servlet.FileDownload?file=015PC000003CCtJ", "No Support")
      )
    ),
    IMAGE("/servlet/servlet.FileDownload?file=015PC000003CCtJ", "No Support")
  )
),
IF(
  OR(
    AND(Fusebill2014__Fusebill_Customer_Account_Status__c = "PoorStanding", Fusebill2014__FusebillData_Status__c = "PoorStanding"),
    AND(Fusebill2014__Fusebill_Customer_Account_Status__c = "Good", Fusebill2014__FusebillData_Status__c = "Cancelled")
  ),
  IMAGE("/servlet/servlet.FileDownload?file=015PC000005kxDV", "Past Due"),
  IF(
    OR(
      AND(Fusebill2014__Fusebill_Customer_Account_Status__c = "Good", Fusebill2014__FusebillData_Status__c = "Active"),
      AND(Fusebill2014__Fusebill_Customer_Account_Status__c = "", ISPICKVAL(Account_Status__c, "Legacy: Paid Support"))
    ),
    IF(Customer_Residual_Rating__c < 4,
      IMAGE("/servlet/servlet.FileDownload?file=015PC000003CCwX", "Active Support"),
      IF(Customer_Residual_Rating__c > 3,
        IMAGE("/servlet/servlet.FileDownload?file=015PC000003CAt8", "VIP Support"),
        IMAGE("/servlet/servlet.FileDownload?file=015PC000003CCtJ", "No Support")
      )
    ),
    IMAGE("/servlet/servlet.FileDownload?file=015PC000003CCtJ", "No Support")
  )
)
)

fields.name: Health_Score_Percentage_Change__c
fields.label: Health Score Percentage Change
fields.formula:
IF(
    OR(
        ISBLANK(Previous_Health_Score__c),
        Previous_Health_Score__c = 0,
        ISBLANK(Latest_Health_Score__c)
    ),
    NULL,
    ((Latest_Health_Score__c - Previous_Health_Score__c) / Previous_Health_Score__c) * 100
)
fields.desc: Calculates the percentage change of Health Score

fields.name: Health_Score_Trend__c
fields.label: Health Score Trend
fields.formula:
IF(ISBLANK(Health_Score_Percentage_Change__c),"",
IF(Health_Score_Percentage_Change__c >= 10, IMAGE("/resource/Upgreen", "Up", 58, 58),
IF(Health_Score_Percentage_Change__c <= -20, IMAGE("/resource/downred", "Down", 58, 58),
IF(Health_Score_Percentage_Change__c <= -10, IMAGE("/resource/downyellow", "Down", 58, 58),
IF(Health_Score_Percentage_Change__c == 0, IMAGE("/resource/rightblue", "No change", 58, 58),
"")))))

fields.name: ActOnIt__IsDeletable__c
fields.label: Is Deletable
fields.formula:
IF(

/*Activities inheriting the global settings are deletable after a globally defined retention period (see Custom Metadata Setting)*/
ISPICKVAL(ActOnIt__Action__r.ActOnIt__DeleteSetting__c,'Inherit'),

IF( DATEVALUE(NOW()- $CustomMetadata.ActOnIt__ActOnItObjectSettings__mdt.ActOnIt__Activity.ActOnIt__DataRetentionPeriod__c)  >  DATEVALUE( ActOnIt__ExecutedDateTime__c ), true, false),

IF(

/*Don't delete protected messages*/
ISPICKVAL(ActOnIt__Action__r.ActOnIt__DeleteSetting__c,'Do Not Delete')

/*Don't delete messages that have no explicit delete settings*/
|| ISBLANK(TEXT(ActOnIt__Action__r.ActOnIt__DeleteSetting__c))
|| ISBLANK(ActOnIt__Action__r.ActOnIt__RetentionPeriod__c)

/*Don't delete messages that are within the retention period*/
|| (ISPICKVAL(ActOnIt__Action__r.ActOnIt__DeleteSetting__c,'Delete After X Days')
&& DATEVALUE(NOW()-ActOnIt__Action__r.ActOnIt__RetentionPeriod__c) <= DATEVALUE( ActOnIt__ExecutedDateTime__c ))

,false,true))
fields.desc: This field controls whether the record is visible to the AOI delete processor. IsDeletable = false, means the record is protected from deletion.

fields.label: Description
fields.desc: The purpose of this mapping rule.
fields.help: The purpose of this mapping rule.

fields.name: ActOnIt__MatchingLogic__c
fields.label: Matching Logic
fields.desc:
[1] Activity (Only) - Aka 'By Anyone' - Link the related activity to the source activity, irrespective of the Owner.
[2] Activity and Owner - Aka 'By User' - Only link the related activity to the source activity if the owners of the activities match.

Why? If you would like to track the time between the source activity and the related activity;
Choose [1] if you want to report on when ANY user executes/triggers the related activity. 
Choose [2] if you want to report on when the SAME user executes/triggers the related activity.
fields.help:
[1] Activity (Only) - Choose this option if you want to report on when ANY user executes/triggers the related activity. 

[2] Activity and Owner - Choose this option if you want to report on when the SAME user executes/triggers the related activity.

fields.name: ActOnIt__MaxNotificationGroupExpansionDepth__c
fields.label: Max Notification Group Expansion Depth
fields.desc: Controls how deep the notification processor will traverse nested group structures to identify target users. A higher value ensures broader user reach but may impact processing time. Recommended range: 2-5 for optimal performance.
fields.help: Controls how deep the notification processor will traverse nested group structures to identify target users. If a notification is sent to a group that contains sub-groups, this setting determines how many levels down the hierarchy will be explored to find recipients. A higher value ensures broader user reach but may impact processing time. Recommended range: 2-5 for optimal performance.

fields.name: ActOnIt__MessageInboxLimit__c
fields.label: Message Inbox Message Limit
fields.desc:
The maximum number of messages that will be displayed in the Message Inbox at one time. Once exceeded a counter will be displayed (i.e. showing 10 of 15). Older messages will be revealed as new messages are managed (hidden or snoozed).

Note - An admin can override the default when adding the component to the utility via the lightning app manager. If neither are specified the default will be 10. Be careful when choosing to increase this limit as Act On It reporting will assume any messages displayed to the user have been ‘seen’.
fields.help: The maximum number of messages that will be displayed in the Message Inbox at one time. Once exceeded a counter will be displayed (i.e. showing 10 of 15). Older messages will be revealed as new messages are managed (hidden or snoozed).

fields.name: ActOnIt__MessageLimitMessageCount__c
fields.label: Message Limit - Message Count
fields.desc: This setting works in combination with the 'Message Limit - Time Period' setting. This is the maximum number of messages that will be received by a user within the configured time period. The default message count is 10 and the default time period is 60 seconds. This means users will receive a maximum of 10 messages per rolling 60 second time period. Subsequent messages will 'Bounce' with the reason 'Limit Exceeded'.

fields.name: ActOnIt__MessageLimitPerCycle__c
fields.label: Message Limit Per Cycle
fields.desc: The number of messages that will be processed by the Scheduled Message processor per cycle. If scheduled messages exceed this number they will be broken into batches and process separately to avoid platform limits.
fields.help: The number of messages that will be processed by the Scheduled Message processor per cycle. If scheduled messages exceed this number they will be broken into batches and process separately to avoid platform limits.

fields.name: ActOnIt__MessageLimitTimePeriod__c
fields.label: Message Limit - Time Period (Seconds)
fields.desc: This setting works in combination with the 'Message Limit - Message Count' setting. This is the time period (in Seconds) Act On It will monitor messages received by a user against the configured 'Message Limit - Message Count'. The default time period is 60 seconds and the default message count is 10. This means users will receive a maximum of 10 messages per rolling 60 second time period. Subsequent messages will 'Bounce' with the reason 'Limit Exceeded'.

fields.name: ActOnIt__MessageQueryDelay__c
fields.label: Message Query Delay
fields.desc: The amount of time (milliseconds) between the time the message inbox is awoken by a new message and when it attempts to query the message details from Salesforce. This gap is to allow time for triggers and related processing to take place.  If your users report that their message inbox is refreshing, but no messages are appearing, we recommend you increase this value by one or two seconds (1000/2000 milliseconds). Alternatively, you can reduce this setting to increase the speed of your alerts.
fields.help: The amount of time (milliseconds) between the time the message inbox is awoken by a new message and when it attempts to query the message details from Salesforce. This gap is to allow time for triggers and related processing to take place.

fields.name: ActOnIt__IsDeletable__c
fields.label: Is Deletable
fields.formula:
IF( 

/*Messages inheriting the global settings are deletable after a globally defined retention period (see Custom Metadata Setting)*/
ISPICKVAL(ActOnIt__MessageType__r.ActOnIt__DeleteSetting__c,'Inherit'),

IF( DATEVALUE(NOW()- $CustomMetadata.ActOnIt__ActOnItObjectSettings__mdt.ActOnIt__MessageRecipients.ActOnIt__DataRetentionPeriod__c)  >  DATEVALUE( CreatedDate), true, false),

IF(

/*Don't delete protected messages*/
ISPICKVAL(ActOnIt__MessageType__r.ActOnIt__DeleteSetting__c,'Do Not Delete') 

/*Don't delete messages that have no explicit delete settings*/ 
|| ISBLANK(TEXT(ActOnIt__MessageType__r.ActOnIt__DeleteSetting__c))
|| ISBLANK(ActOnIt__MessageType__r.ActOnIt__RetentionPeriod__c)

/*Don't delete messages that are within the retention period*/
|| (ISPICKVAL(ActOnIt__MessageType__r.ActOnIt__DeleteSetting__c,'Delete After X Days') 
&&  DATEVALUE(NOW()-ActOnIt__MessageType__r.ActOnIt__RetentionPeriod__c)  <=  DATEVALUE(CreatedDate))

,false,true))
fields.desc: This field controls whether the record is visible to the AOI delete processor. IsDeletable = false, means the record is protected from deletion.

fields.name: ActOnIt__SLAMetOnTime__c
fields.label: SLA Met On Time
fields.formula:
AND(
    NOT( ISBLANK( ActOnIt__SLAFirstCompletionDateTime__c ) ),
    NOT( ISBLANK( ActOnIt__SLADueDateTime__c ) ),
    ActOnIt__SLAFirstCompletionDateTime__c <= ActOnIt__SLADueDateTime__c
)
fields.desc:
True when a recipient satisfied this event's response target before the deadline.

Exists because SOQL cannot compare two fields to each other, so 'was the first completion before the due date' is impossible to express in a query filter. This field resolves that comparison at the record level, where it can then be filtered and grouped.

Deliberately contains no NOW() or TODAY(). A formula using dynamic date functions is non-deterministic, and Salesforce will not allow a non-deterministic formula in a SOQL WHERE clause - which would make it useless for exactly the reporting it exists to serve. The 'still open and past its deadline' case is therefore evaluated in the query instead, by comparing the due date to a bind variable.
fields.help: A recipient responded before this event's deadline. Exists as a stored field because SOQL cannot compare two fields to each other, so this resolves the comparison at record level where reporting can filter and group on it.

fields.name: ActOnIt__ReadDateTime__c
fields.label: Read Date/Time
fields.desc:
Permanent first-acknowledgement timestamp. Set once, never cleared. Analytics source of truth, independent of IsRead__c (display state only, user-toggleable).

Set on active engagement only. Never on inbox load:
- Hover 2.5s (acknowledgeMessage): ReadDateTime only, IsRead__c unchanged.
- Card click / View Record (viewedRecord).
- Close/Hide (hideMessages).
- Snooze (acknowledgeMessage called in snooze callback).
- Explicit mark as read (markMessagesRead).
- Mobile message detail open.
- Prompt delivery: set at insert (load = acknowledged by definition).

ReadVsUnread__c does NOT gate this field. It only controls IsRead__c on inbox load.
Never cleared: marking as unread resets IsRead__c only.
fields.help: Permanent first-acknowledgement timestamp. Set once, never cleared. Analytics source of truth for whether a message was ever acknowledged. Independent of IsRead__c, which controls inbox display state only.

For Act On It to detect page views a message must be visible in the guidance console on a record page OR a user must select the 'View Record' navigation action from an alert message. To capture the very first time a user views a record, we recommend creating an Act On It automation to feature an introductory guidance message in the guidance console with tracking enabled.
fields.help: The earliest date/time Act On It could identiy this user has viewed the record. Please see the field description for more details.

fields.name: ActOnIt__SLADueDateTime__c
fields.label: SLA Due Date/Time
fields.desc: The date/time by which this message must reach its configured stop event. Calculated on delivery from the Message Type's SLA target, honouring business hours where configured. Stored rather than derived, so a later change to the target does not move the deadline of a message already in flight.
fields.help: The deadline for responding to this message, set when it was delivered and honouring business hours where configured. Fixed at that point on purpose, so later changes to the target never move the deadline of a message already in flight.

fields.name: ActOnIt__SLAElapsedSeconds__c
fields.label: SLA Elapsed Seconds
fields.desc: The elapsed time in seconds between the SLA clock starting and stopping. Calculated in Apex because business-hours arithmetic cannot be expressed in a formula. This is the value the SLA Grade formula compares against the configured thresholds.
fields.help: How long the response took, in seconds, measured in business hours where the message type is configured that way. Used for averages and for grading how comfortably a target was met. It does not decide whether it was met - SLA Met On Time does.

fields.name: ActOnIt__SLASatisfiedByPeer__c
fields.label: SLA Satisfied by Peer
fields.desc: Set when another recipient of the same message satisfied the SLA first. Prevents a single event sent to many people from recording many breaches when the work was in fact done. Messages flagged here are excluded from individual breach counts.
fields.help: Another recipient of the same message responded first, so this person is excused and is excluded from both the met and the breached figures. Stops one event sent to twenty people recording nineteen breaches for work that was in fact done.

fields.name: ActOnIt__SLAStartDateTime__c
fields.label: SLA Start Date/Time
fields.desc:
When the SLA clock started. Written at the moment the deadline is set, and read back when the clock stops, so elapsed time is measured over exactly the window the deadline was calculated from.

The start used to be re-derived from Delivery Date/Time or Message Recieved Date/Time. That only works while it is recoverable from a stored timestamp, and it stops being recoverable once the start can be deferred: a message arriving outside business hours does not start its clock until the recipient is next in the inbox during business hours, and that moment is held nowhere else. Without it, elapsed time would run from business open and a fast response would be graded as a slow one.

Writable, and authoritative whenever populated. ActOnItSLAManager.resolveStartDateTime prefers this field and falls back to the derived value when blank, so messages created before it existed keep working with no backfill - and a Message Type could nominate its own start from the source record in future.
fields.help: When the response target clock started. Usually set on delivery or receipt. With business hours on, a message arriving out of hours waits, then starts when the recipient is next in their inbox. Blank on older messages, which measure from receipt.

fields.name: ActOnIt__SLAStopDateTime__c
fields.label: SLA Stop Date/Time
fields.desc: The date/time the SLA clock stopped, captured from whichever lifecycle event the Message Type nominates as its SLA Stop Event. Populated once and never cleared, so analytics does not have to re-derive which of the lifecycle timestamps applied.
fields.help: When the clock stopped, taken from whichever of the message type's response events happened first. Set once and never changed, so a recorded response time cannot drift. Blank means the recipient has not yet responded.

fields.label: Viewed Record Activity

fields.name: ActOnIt__ViewedRecordDateTime__c
fields.label: Viewed Record Date/Time
fields.desc: The date/time the user clicked to view the record from this message or viewed the message from the record page (guidance console). The earliest date/time a user viewed the record will be captured in the 'Record First Viewed Date/Time' field. This can be used to identify how quickly a user clicked to view the details after receiving the alert message.
fields.help: The date/time the user clicked to view the record from this message or viewed the message from the record page (guidance console). The earliest date/time a user viewed the record will be captured in the 'Record First Viewed Date/Time' field.

fields.name: ActOnIt__ViewedRecord__c
fields.label: Viewed Record
fields.desc:
Indicates whether the user has:
1) Selected the 'view record' action to navigate to the record from an alert message.
OR
2) Viewed the message from within the guidance console on a record page.
If they do not select the action and the message is not visible in the console, this will remain false. To capture when the record is first viewed, we recommend adding the Act On It Guidance Console to the layout and introducing an introductory guidance message.

fields.name: ActOnIt__WasUseful__c
fields.label: Was Useful
fields.desc:
Whether the recipient found this notification useful. Set by the thumbs up / thumbs down control on the message itself.

Replaces the survey that collected Usefulness & Relevance, Actionability, Timeliness & Noticeability, Additional Comments and Continue This Notification. That survey asked an agent to open a modal and answer five questions about a notification they had already dealt with, so it was rarely completed - and nothing in the product read the answers back. One question answerable in a single click, feeding reporting, collects far more than five that do not.

Blank means unanswered, which is the normal state - most notifications will never be rated, and an unrated notification is not a negative one. Report on the ratio of Yes to No rather than on Yes as a share of everything sent.

The legacy fields remain in place. They cannot be removed from a released managed package, and historical responses are still valid for the period they were collected in.
fields.help: Whether the recipient found this notification useful, from the thumbs up / thumbs down control on the message. Blank means they did not answer, which is normal - treat it as no opinion rather than as a negative.

fields.name: ActOnIt__ExpiryDateTime__c
fields.label: Expiry Date Time
fields.formula:
/*Alert messages never expire in Test Drive Org*/

If( $Setup.ActOnIt__ActOnItSettings__c.ActOnIt__IsTestDrive__c,Now()+1,

If( ActOnIt__MessageLog__r.ActOnIt__MessageType__r.ActOnIt__ExpiryValue__c = 0 ,now()+(60/24/60), CASE( ActOnIt__MessageLog__r.ActOnIt__MessageType__r.ActOnIt__ExpiryUnits__c , 
"Seconds",   ActOnIt__MostRecentDeliveryDateTime__c + (ActOnIt__MessageLog__r.ActOnIt__MessageType__r.ActOnIt__ExpiryValue__c/24/60/60) , 
"Minutes", ActOnIt__MostRecentDeliveryDateTime__c + (ActOnIt__MessageLog__r.ActOnIt__MessageType__r.ActOnIt__ExpiryValue__c/24/60),
"Hours", ActOnIt__MostRecentDeliveryDateTime__c + (ActOnIt__MessageLog__r.ActOnIt__MessageType__r.ActOnIt__ExpiryValue__c/24), 
"Days", ActOnIt__MostRecentDeliveryDateTime__c + ActOnIt__MessageLog__r.ActOnIt__MessageType__r.ActOnIt__ExpiryValue__c,
"Weeks", ActOnIt__MostRecentDeliveryDateTime__c + (ActOnIt__MessageLog__r.ActOnIt__MessageType__r.ActOnIt__ExpiryValue__c*7)


,now()+(60/24/60))))
fields.desc: The Date/Time the message will expire calculated from the delivery date (created date) and the configured Message Type Expiry settings. Once expired the message will no longer appear in the messages component.
fields.help: The Date/Time the message will expire calculated from the delivery date (created date) and the configured Message Type Expiry settings. Once expired the message will no longer appear in the messages component.

fields.name: ActOnIt__IsDeletable__c
fields.label: Is Deletable

&&  DATEVALUE(NOW()-ActOnIt__MessageType__r.ActOnIt__RetentionPeriod__c)  <=  DATEVALUE( ActOnIt__DeliveryDateTime__c ))

,false,true))
fields.desc: This field controls whether the record is visible to the AOI delete processor. IsDeletable = false, means the record is protected from deletion.

fields.name: ActOnIt__Missed__c
fields.label: Missed
fields.formula:
/*Message is unread and went away before it was read, AND the work was never done.

Completed__c EXCLUDES a message from being missed. It used to sit inside the OR below, which made
completing a message one of the ways to be counted as missing it - the exact opposite of the truth.
Removing it from the OR was not enough on its own: a message that was completed but also hidden or
expired still matched, so a completed message could still be reported as missed. It has to be a
gate on the whole expression.

A completed message is not missed - the reason the message existed has been dealt with, which is a
win even if the message itself was never read. Analytics already takes this view (W_MISSED excludes
records with a completion action), so this brings the field into line with the reporting built on it.

Note: ActOnItMessageLogTriggerHandler carries a compensating predicate on its message throttling
query so that the set of messages counted toward a user's rate limit is unchanged by this fix.
That predicate remains correct with this gate in place - see ActOnItSLARegressionTest.*/
AND( NOT( ActOnIt__Completed__c ),
ActOnIt__Unread__c ,
OR( ActOnIt__Expired__c ,  ActOnIt__IsHidden__c , ActOnIt__Blocked__c ))
fields.desc: Indicates the Message was hidden or expired before user could view it.
fields.help: Indicates the Message was hidden or expired before user could view it.

fields.name: ActOnIt__MostRecentDeliveryDateTime__c
fields.label: Most Recent Delivery Date Time
fields.formula:
IF( 
AND(
NOT(ISBLANK(ActOnIt__SnoozeEndDateTime__c )), ActOnIt__SnoozeEndDateTime__c >  ActOnIt__DeliveryDateTime__c) , ActOnIt__SnoozeEndDateTime__c ,ActOnIt__DeliveryDateTime__c )

fields.name: ActOnIt__SLAGrade__c
fields.label: SLA Grade
fields.formula:
IF( OR( NOT( ActOnIt__MessageType__r.ActOnIt__SLAEnabled__c ),
        ISBLANK( ActOnIt__SLAStopDateTime__c ),
        ISBLANK( ActOnIt__MessageType__r.ActOnIt__SLATargetSeconds__c ) ), '',

/* Met or not is decided once, by the same field SLA Outcome uses. */
IF( NOT( ActOnIt__SLAMetOnTime__c ), 'Breached',

/* Met, so grade how comfortably. Elapsed and the thresholds share a clock, so this holds. */
IF( AND( NOT( ISBLANK( ActOnIt__MessageType__r.ActOnIt__SLAGoldSeconds__c ) ),
         NOT( ISBLANK( ActOnIt__SLAElapsedSeconds__c ) ),
         ActOnIt__SLAElapsedSeconds__c <= ActOnIt__MessageType__r.ActOnIt__SLAGoldSeconds__c ), 'Gold',

IF( AND( NOT( ISBLANK( ActOnIt__MessageType__r.ActOnIt__SLASilverSeconds__c ) ),
         NOT( ISBLANK( ActOnIt__SLAElapsedSeconds__c ) ),
         ActOnIt__SLAElapsedSeconds__c <= ActOnIt__MessageType__r.ActOnIt__SLASilverSeconds__c ), 'Silver',

'Bronze' ))))
fields.desc:
The tiered grade achieved: Gold, Silver, Bronze or Breached. Blank where SLA tracking is not enabled or the clock has not yet stopped.

Whether the target was MET is decided by SLA Met On Time, the same field SLA Outcome uses, so the two can never contradict each other. Grade previously made its own judgement by comparing elapsed seconds to the target, which disagreed with Outcome whenever business hours were in use: the due date is pushed forward across non-working time while elapsed seconds are compressed to exclude it, so a message could stop hours before its deadline and still be graded Breached.

Elapsed seconds are still used, but only to decide HOW WELL a met target was met. The thresholds and the elapsed time are measured on the same clock, so that comparison is sound.

Reads the Message Type's live thresholds, so adjusting a threshold regrades historical messages to the current standard.
fields.help: Gold, Silver, Bronze or Breached. Blank until the clock stops. Graded against the message type's current thresholds, so adjusting a threshold regrades past messages to the standard you hold people to today.

fields.name: ActOnIt__SLAMetOnTime__c
fields.label: SLA Met On Time
fields.formula:
AND(
    NOT( ISBLANK( ActOnIt__SLAStopDateTime__c ) ),
    NOT( ISBLANK( ActOnIt__SLADueDateTime__c ) ),
    ActOnIt__SLAStopDateTime__c <= ActOnIt__SLADueDateTime__c
)
fields.desc:
True when the response landed on or before the deadline. The single source of truth for whether a response target was met.

Exists because 'on time' was previously answered two different ways: SLA Outcome compared the stop timestamp to the due date, while SLA Grade compared elapsed seconds to the target. Those only agree when business hours are not in use - with business hours the due date is pushed forward across non-working time while elapsed seconds are compressed to exclude it, so the same message could read Met and Breached at once.

Comparing the timestamps is the correct test, because the due date is the commitment actually made. Elapsed seconds remain useful for averages and for grading how comfortably a target was met, but no longer decide whether it was met.

Contains no NOW() by design - a non-deterministic formula cannot be used in a SOQL filter, which would make it useless for reporting.
fields.help: The response landed on or before the deadline. The single source of truth for whether a target was met - both SLA Outcome and SLA Grade read it, so they can never disagree. Compares the two stored timestamps rather than elapsed time.

fields.name: ActOnIt__SLAOutcome__c
fields.label: SLA Outcome
fields.formula:
IF( NOT( ActOnIt__MessageType__r.ActOnIt__SLAEnabled__c ), 'Not Applicable',

/* A bounced message is a delivery failure, never an individual's breach. */
IF( ActOnIt__MessageBounced__c, 'Not Delivered',

IF( ActOnIt__SLASatisfiedByPeer__c, 'Satisfied by Peer',

IF( ISBLANK( ActOnIt__SLADueDateTime__c ), 'Not Applicable',

/* Clock stopped - one of the configured response events happened.
   Uses SLAMetOnTime__c, the same field SLA Grade uses, so the two can never disagree. */
IF( NOT( ISBLANK( ActOnIt__SLAStopDateTime__c ) ),
    IF( ActOnIt__SLAMetOnTime__c, 'Met', 'Breached' ),

/* Closed before any configured response event occurred.

   Only reachable when Closed is NOT one of the configured response events - if it were, closing
   would have stopped the clock in the branch above.

   Auto-closed messages are excluded deliberately: housekeeping performed by the system is not the
   recipient's doing and must never be recorded against them.

   Reads MessageType__r.SLAClosureIsResponse__c rather than testing the multi-select directly:
   Salesforce only allows INCLUDES() on the same object as the picklist, so that test is resolved
   on Message Type and read across as a plain checkbox. */
IF( AND( ActOnIt__IsHidden__c,
         NOT( ActOnIt__IsAutoClosed__c ),
         NOT( ActOnIt__ClosedOnCompletion__c ),
         NOT( ActOnIt__MessageType__r.ActOnIt__SLAClosureIsResponse__c ) ), 'Dismissed',

/* Still open. */
IF( NOW() > ActOnIt__SLADueDateTime__c, 'Breached', 'Pending' )))))))
fields.desc:
The SLA result for this individual recipient.

Met - one of the configured response events happened within the target.
Breached - responded after the target, or still open with the deadline passed.
Dismissed - the message was closed before any of the configured response events had happened. Only possible when Closed is not one of those events. Reported separately from Breached because the two arise differently: a breach is the deadline passing, a dismissal is the message being closed first.
Satisfied by Peer - another recipient of the same message responded first, so this person is excused.
Not Delivered - the message bounced, so the recipient never had the chance to respond and is not held accountable.
Pending - still open and inside the deadline.
Not Applicable - SLA tracking is not enabled, or no deadline was set.
fields.help: Met = answered in time. Breached = answered late, or open past the deadline. Dismissed = closed before a response event occurred. Satisfied by Peer = a colleague answered first. Not Delivered = it bounced, so they never had the chance. Pending = open and in time.

fields.name: ActOnIt__SLASortDueDateTime__c
fields.label: SLA Sort Due Date/Time
fields.formula:
/* MessageType__r.SLAEnabled__c is checked first so that switching tracking off stops these
   messages being prioritised immediately, without having to clear the stored due dates. */
IF( AND( ActOnIt__MessageType__r.ActOnIt__SLAEnabled__c,
         NOT( ISBLANK( ActOnIt__SLADueDateTime__c ) ),
         ISBLANK( ActOnIt__SLAStopDateTime__c ) ),
    ActOnIt__SLADueDateTime__c,
    null )
fields.desc:
The deadline, but only while the message is still outstanding. Blank once answered, and blank for messages that never had a target.

Exists purely to make the 'prioritise by response target' sort correct, which SOQL cannot otherwise express. An ORDER BY cannot contain a CASE expression, so there is no way to say 'sort by deadline, but only for work that is still outstanding' without a stored value to sort on.

Sorting on the raw stop date instead groups 'not yet answered' together - which lumps outstanding work in with messages that have no target at all. When nothing is outstanding, that pushed untimed messages above answered ones for no reason.

With this field the inbox orders by it ascending, nulls last: outstanding work rises in deadline order, and everything else - answered, or never tracked - falls through to the normal chronological order together.

Contains no NOW() by design, so it stays usable in an ORDER BY.
fields.help: The deadline, but only while the message is still outstanding. Blank once answered and blank where no target is tracked. Used to float outstanding work to the top of the inbox without disturbing the order of everything else.

fields.name: ActOnIt__SpeedToAcknowledge__c

fields.desc: Elapsed seconds from inbox arrival (MessageRecievedDateTime__c) to first acknowledgement (ReadDateTime__c). Excludes delivery time. Null when the message has not been acknowledged or not yet delivered.
fields.help: Elapsed seconds from inbox arrival to first acknowledgement, excluding delivery time.

fields.help: The elapsed time (in Seconds) from when the message was received to when the recipient clicked to view the record.

fields.name: ActOnIt__SpeedToDelivery__c
fields.label: Speed to Delivery
fields.formula: IF( NOT(ISBLANK( ActOnIt__MessageRecievedDateTime__c )), ((( ActOnIt__MessageRecievedDateTime__c - CreatedDate ) * 24 ) * 60 ) * 60, null)
fields.desc: Elapsed seconds from message dispatch (CreatedDate) to inbox arrival (MessageRecievedDateTime__c). Null when the message has not yet been delivered.
fields.help: Elapsed seconds from message dispatch to inbox arrival.

fields.name: ActOnIt__StatusWithIcon__c
fields.label: Status
fields.formula:
/*
Bounced - Never Delivered
Missed - Unread and expired (never loaded or read before expiry)
Expired - Delivered, read, and expired (never closed)
Opted Out - User opted out of messages of this type
Snoozed - User snoozed message
Completed - The recipient executed an action nominated as a completion action on the message type
Closed - User closed/cleared the message
Pending Delivery - Sent but not yet loaded in the recipient's inbox (user offline, inbox not yet visited, or hidden behind the Show More limit)
Unread - Delivered but not yet read by user
Open - Read and active in the Message Inbox
*/

IF( ActOnIt__MessageBounced__c, '🔄 Bounced',

IF( ActOnIt__Completed__c, '🎉 Completed',

/* Never reached inbox and expired = Missed */
IF( AND( ISPICKVAL(ActOnIt__Type__c,'Alert'), ISBLANK( ActOnIt__MessageRecievedDateTime__c ), ActOnIt__Expired__c ), '❌ Missed',

/* Reached inbox but never acknowledged and expired = Ignored */
IF( AND( ISPICKVAL(ActOnIt__Type__c,'Alert'), ISBLANK( ActOnIt__ReadDateTime__c ), NOT(ISBLANK( ActOnIt__MessageRecievedDateTime__c )), ActOnIt__Expired__c ), '⏭️ Ignored',

IF( ActOnIt__Blocked__c, '🚫 Opted Out',

IF( ActOnIt__IsHidden__c, '✅ Closed',

IF( ActOnIt__IsSnoozed__c, '😴 Snoozed',

IF( ActOnIt__Expired__c, '⏳ Expired',

/* Not yet loaded in inbox */
IF( ISBLANK( ActOnIt__MessageRecievedDateTime__c ), '📤 Pending Delivery',

IF( ISBLANK( ActOnIt__ReadDateTime__c ), '📪 Unread',

'📬 Open'

))))))))))
fields.desc:
Bounced - Never Delivered
Missed - Unread and expired (never loaded or read before expiry)
Expired - Delivered, read, and expired (never closed)
Opted Out - User opted out of messages of this type
Snoozed - User snoozed message
Closed - User closed/cleared the message
Pending Delivery - Sent but not yet loaded in the recipient's inbox (user offline, inbox not yet visited, or hidden behind the Show More limit)
Unread - Delivered but not yet read by user
Completed - The recipient executed an action nominated as a completion action on the message type
Open - Read and remains active in the Message Inbox

fields.name: ActOnIt__Status__c
fields.label: Status
fields.formula:
/*
Bounced - Never Delivered
Missed - Unread and expired (never loaded or read before expiry)
Expired - Delivered, read, and expired (never closed)
Opted Out - User opted out of messages of this type
Snoozed - User snoozed message
Completed - The recipient executed an action nominated as a completion action on the message type
Closed - User closed/cleared the message
Pending Delivery - Sent but not yet loaded in the recipient's inbox (user offline, or inbox not yet visited)
Unread - Delivered but not yet read by user
Open - Read and active in the Message Inbox
*/

IF( ActOnIt__MessageBounced__c, 'Bounced',

IF( ActOnIt__Completed__c, 'Completed',

/* Unread and Expired = Missed (covers both never-received and received-but-unread) */
IF( AND( ISPICKVAL(ActOnIt__Type__c,'Alert'), ActOnIt__Unread__c, ActOnIt__Expired__c ), 'Missed',

IF( ActOnIt__Blocked__c, 'Opted Out',

IF( ActOnIt__IsHidden__c, 'Closed',

IF( ActOnIt__IsSnoozed__c, 'Snoozed',

IF( ActOnIt__Expired__c, 'Expired',

/* Not yet loaded in inbox */
IF( ISBLANK( ActOnIt__MessageRecievedDateTime__c ), 'Pending Delivery',

IF( ISBLANK( ActOnIt__ReadDateTime__c ), 'Unread',

'Open'

)))))))))
fields.desc:
Bounced - Never Delivered
Missed - Delivered, but expired before being read
Expired - Delivered, read, and expired (never closed)
Opted Out - User opted out of messages of this type
Snoozed - User snoozed message
Closed - User closed/cleared the message
Pending Delivery - Sent but not yet loaded in the recipient's inbox (user offline, or inbox not yet visited)
Unread - Delivered but not yet read by user
Completed - The recipient executed an action nominated as a completion action on the message type
Open - Read and remains active in the Message Inbox

fields.name: ActOnIt__Unread__c
fields.label: Unread
fields.desc: UI display indicator only. True when the message is currently showing as unread in the recipient's inbox (IsRead__c is false). This is the user's display preference and can be toggled. For analytics and reporting, use ReadDateTime__c (the permanent first-acknowledgement timestamp) instead.
fields.help: Reflects the current inbox display state. True = showing as unread. For analytics, use ReadDateTime__c to determine whether a message was ever acknowledged.

fields.name: ActOnIt__ActionCompletionDateTime__c
fields.label: Action Completed Date/Time
fields.desc: The Date/Time the action was completed. For Flow actions this will be set on successful completion of the Flow. For all other actions this will be set to when the user selects the action button.
fields.help: The Date/Time the action was completed. For Flow actions this will be set on successful completion of the Flow. For all other actions this will be set to when the user selects the action button.

fields.name: ActOnIt__ActionCountBeforeCompletion__c
fields.label: Action Count Before Completion
fields.desc: How many times was this action taken before the message was marked as complete? This is incremented each time the action is taken until (and including when) the parent message is marked as complete. It can help with identifying certain behaviors, such as how many times the user viewed the record (the action) before they executed an activity that completed the initial request (the message).
fields.help: How many times was this action taken before the message was marked as complete?

fields.name: ActOnIt__ActionCount__c
fields.label: Action Count
fields.desc: The number of times the action was successfully executed by the user.
fields.help: The number of times the action was successfully executed by the user.

fields.name: ActOnIt__InitialActionDateTime__c
fields.label: Action Initiated Date/Time
fields.desc: The Date/Time the recipient first took this action.
fields.help: The Date/Time the recipient first took this action.

fields.name: ActOnIt__LatestActionDateTime__c
fields.label: Latest Action Date/Time
fields.desc: The most recent date/time this action was taken by this user and in relation to this message.
fields.help: The most recent date/time this action was taken by this user and in relation to this message.

fields.name: ActOnIt__IsComplete__c
fields.label: Is Complete
fields.desc: Indicates whether or not the action was successfully completed by the user. Not all actions will be completed e.g. a Macro that fails to execute all actions or an incomplete Screen Flow action.
fields.help: Indicates whether or not the action was successfully completed by the user. Not all actions will be completed e.g. a Macro that fails to execute all actions or an incomplete Screen Flow action.

fields.name: ActOnIt__IsCompletionAction__c
fields.label: Is Completion Action
fields.desc: A completion action is any nominated action that, once executed successfully, results in the parent message being marked as complete. Only the first completion action executed will be tagged as true.
fields.help: Did this action result in the completion of the related message?

fields.name: ActOnIt__SpeedToAction_RecordCreated__c
fields.label: Speed to Action: From Record Created
fields.desc: The elapsed time (in seconds) from when the message's related record was created to when the user first executed the action.
fields.help: The elapsed time (in seconds) from when the message's related record was created to when the user first executed the action.

fields.name: ActOnIt__SpeedToAction_ViewedRecord__c
fields.label: Speed to Action: From Record Viewed
fields.desc: The elapsed time (in seconds) from when the message's related record was first viewed to when the user executed the action. Note - The first record view date/time is captured when the user first clicks to view the record from an alert message (inbox or email assistant) OR views an alert or prompt message within the Guidance Console on the record page.
fields.help: The elapsed time (in seconds) from when the message's related record was viewed to when the user first executed the action. Note - The first record view date/time is captured when the user first clicks to view the record from an alert message (inbox or email assistant) OR views an alert or prompt message within the Guidance Console on the record page.

fields.name: ActOnIt__SpeedToAction__c
fields.label: Speed to Action: From Message Viewed
fields.desc: The elapsed time (in Seconds) from when the message was received by the user to when they first executed the action.
fields.help: The elapsed time (in Seconds) from when the message was received by the user to when they first executed the action.

fields.name: ActOnIt__SpeedToCompletion_RecordCreated__c
fields.label: Speed to Complete: From Record Created
fields.desc: The elapsed time (in seconds) from when the message's related record was created to when the user completed the action.
fields.help: The elapsed time (in seconds) from when the message's related record was created to when the user completed the action.

fields.name: ActOnIt__SpeedToCompletion_ViewedRecord__c
fields.label: Speed to Complete: From Record Viewed
fields.desc: The elapsed time (in seconds) from when the message's related record was first viewed to when the user completed the action. Note - Viewed Record is captured when the user clicks to view the record from an alert message (inbox or email assistant) OR views the alert or prompt message within the Guidance Console on the record page.
fields.help: The elapsed time (in seconds) from when the message's related record was first viewed to when the user completed the action.

fields.name: ActOnIt__SpeedToCompletion__c
fields.label: Speed to Complete: From Message Viewed
fields.desc: The elapsed time (in Seconds) from when the message was received to when the user completed the action.
fields.help: The elapsed time (in Seconds) from when the message was received to when the user completed the action.

fields.name: ActOnIt__BusinessHours__c
fields.label: Business Hours
fields.desc: The operational hours used to calculate the elapsed time in business hours for select relative date/time conditions for this automation e.g. Last Modified Date Time is less than 3 Business Hours ago.

fields.name: ActOnIt__ChangeFieldAPINames__c
fields.label: ChangeFieldAPINames
fields.desc: A comma separated list of field (API) names. At least one of these fields must change to meet the criteria for a record update Notification event

fields.name: ActOnIt__ConditionLogic__c

fields.desc: Determines whether the processor requires all conditions to be valid & applicable before the criteria is met for the Notification.

fields.name: ActOnIt__DataEventType__c

fields.name: ActOnIt__DefaultTimeZone__c
fields.label: Default TimeZone (SidKey)
fields.desc: Time based conditions are evaluated based on the specified TimeZone. If a Related User is selected the system will attempt to run in that user's TimeZone. If it is not set or is unidentifiable (i.e. the Related User is not set or is not a valid user), the default will be applied.

fields.name: ActOnIt__ExpiryDate__c

fields.desc: The (optional) date of expiry. If set the Notification will be deactivated by the processor on the specified date.
fields.help: The (optional) date of expiry. If set the Notification will be deactivated by the processor on the specified date.

fields.name: ActOnIt__MaxRecordCount__c
fields.label: Max Record Count
fields.desc: The cut-off record count for Time Based Notifications (Max 1000). If the number of records (meeting the configured criteria) exceeds this limit, no messages will be sent. This is to avoid inadvertently publishing excessive volumes of messages to users. If the limit is exceeded a record will be logged to the Error Log for alerting System Admins. fields.desc: If enabled, messages will support multiple records. Applicable to Time Based Notifications (only). fields.help: Applicable to prompts. This determines the order in which prompts will be displayed to users.

fields.name: ActOnIt__RecordAgeLimit__c
fields.label: Record Age Limit (Days)
fields.desc: Only include records created within the configured limit (Last x Days). Default = 365. This helps to increase the selectivity of the underlying SOQL queries reducing the risk of hitting platform limits.

fields.desc:

fields.name: ActOnIt__DeleteSetting__c
fields.label: Delete Setting
fields.desc:
Controls the deletion behavior for related messages.
Never Delete - Records are permanently protected from deletion (by the AOI delete processor).
Delete After X Days - Records are protected from deletion while they remain within the retention period (ActOnIt__RetentionPeriod__c)
Inherit Global Settings - Records are immediately deletable (after close), meaning they can be deleted by the processor based on the globally defined retention period for messages.

Admins & Developers should take note of the Developer Name when creating a new process, flow or trigger to fire messages of this type.

fields.name: ActOnIt__DisplayLocation__c

fields.name: ActOnIt__IsSampleNotification__c

fields.help: Determines whether or not the Utility Component will open (pop up) and focus on message delivery

fields.name: ActOnIt__PrimaryMessageAction__c
fields.label: Primary Message Action
fields.desc: The primary message action is the custom action that secures a space in the footer of the message. This saves 'clicks' for the message recipient by making the primary action instantly visible on the message.
fields.help: The primary message action is the custom action that secures a space in the footer of the message. This saves 'clicks' for the message recipient by making the primary action instantly visible on the message.

fields.name: ActOnIt__ReadVsUnread__c
fields.label: Read vs Unread
fields.desc: When on, messages arrive unread in the recipient's inbox and must be explicitly acknowledged. Useful for notifications where you want recipients to actively confirm they've seen it. When off, messages arrive in a read state with no acknowledgement required, which means lower friction for informational or broadcast messages. Either way, Act On It quietly records when each message is first seen, so your analytics are always accurate.
fields.help: Controls whether messages arrive unread (requiring acknowledgement) or pre-read (no friction). Act On It always records when each message is first seen regardless of this setting, so your read analytics are never affected.

fields.name: ActOnIt__ReleaseStatus__c
fields.label: Release Status
fields.desc:
Live - Messages will be published to users
Trial Mode - Message data will be collected (simulating Live), but messages will not be delivered to users.
fields.help:
Live - Messages will be published to users
Trial Mode - Message data will be collected (simulating Live), but messages will not be delivered to users.

fields.name: ActOnIt__RetentionPeriod__c
fields.label: Retention Period (Days)
fields.desc: The number of days messages will be protected from deletion when the delete settings are set to 'Delete After X Days'.

fields.name: ActOnIt__SLABasis__c
fields.label: SLA Clock Stop
fields.desc:
The events that stop the SLA clock. Whichever of the selected events happens first counts as the response.

Multi-select because organisations do not agree on what 'done' means and often accept more than one thing - a team may be satisfied if the agent opens the record, takes any action, or clears the message.

This also determines what closing a message means, which cannot be inferred any other way. Select Closed and closing the message counts as a response. Leave it out and closing it before any other response event is recorded as Dismissed.

Read = acknowledged. Record Viewed = opened the related record. First Action = clicked any action. Completed = executed a nominated completion action, or Mark as Complete was invoked. Closed = cleared from the inbox.
fields.help: Events that count as a response; the first to happen stops the clock. Read = acknowledged. Record Viewed = opened the record. First Action = any action. Completed = completion action ran. Closed = cleared it. Omit Closed and clearing counts as Dismissed.

fields.name: ActOnIt__SLABusinessHours__c
fields.label: SLA Business Hours
fields.desc: The operating hours used to calculate the SLA due date/time and elapsed time when Apply Business Hours to SLA is enabled. If left blank, the organisation's default business hours are used.
fields.help: The operating hours used to work out the deadline and the elapsed time. Leave blank to use the organisation's default business hours. Only applies when Apply Business Hours to SLA is switched on.

fields.name: ActOnIt__SLAClockStart__c
fields.label: SLA Clock Start
fields.desc: Determines when the SLA clock starts. Delivery measures from the moment the message was dispatched, which is the fairest measure of how the business is performing. Received measures from the moment the recipient's inbox loaded the message, which is the fairest measure of an individual's response because it starts when they were actually told.
fields.help: Delivery = runs from dispatch, the fairest measure of the business. Received = runs from when it reached the recipient's inbox, the fairest measure of a person. With business hours on, one arriving out of hours starts when they are next in their inbox.

fields.name: ActOnIt__SLAEnabled__c
fields.label: SLA Tracking Enabled
fields.desc: Enables SLA (response target) tracking for messages of this type. When enabled, each delivered message is given a due date/time and is graded once the configured stop event occurs. Not supported for Prompt-type messages.
fields.help: Track a response target for messages of this type. Each message gets a deadline, an optional countdown, and a Gold/Silver/Bronze grade once answered. Not available for record-page-only (prompt) message types.

fields.name: ActOnIt__SLAGoldValue__c
fields.label: SLA Gold Threshold
fields.desc: Completing within this time grades the message Gold. Must be less than the Silver threshold, which must be less than the SLA Target. Leave blank to disable Gold grading. History is tracked so threshold changes can be correlated with reported performance.
fields.help: Respond within this time to earn a Gold grade. Uses SLA Target Units. Must be quicker than Silver, which must be quicker than the target. Leave blank to skip Gold and grade everything inside the target as Bronze.

fields.name: ActOnIt__SLASilverValue__c
fields.label: SLA Silver Threshold
fields.desc: Completing within this time, but outside the Gold threshold, grades the message Silver. Anything completed after this but within the SLA Target grades Bronze. Leave blank to disable Silver grading. History is tracked so threshold changes can be correlated with reported performance.
fields.help: Respond within this time, but outside Gold, to earn Silver. Uses SLA Target Units. Anything answered after this but still inside the target grades Bronze. Leave blank to skip Silver.

fields.name: ActOnIt__SLATargetUnits__c
fields.label: SLA Target Units
fields.desc: The unit of time applied to the SLA Target, Gold and Silver thresholds. Seconds and Weeks are deliberately excluded: a sub-minute target is not actionable by a person, and a multi-week target makes a countdown meaningless.
fields.help: The unit applied to the target and to the Gold and Silver thresholds. Minutes, Hours or Days. Seconds and Weeks are excluded on purpose: a sub-minute target is not actionable by a person, and a multi-week one makes a countdown meaningless.

fields.name: ActOnIt__SLATargetValue__c
fields.label: SLA Target
fields.desc: The response target for this message type, expressed in SLA Target Units. Exceeding this value grades the message as Breached. History is tracked on this field so a change to the target can be correlated with a change in reported SLA performance.
fields.help: How long the recipient has to respond, in SLA Target Units. Going past this is a breach. Gold and Silver must both be quicker than this. History is tracked, so a change here can be matched to a change in reported performance.

fields.name: ActOnIt__SLATimerDisplay__c
fields.label: SLA Timer Display
fields.desc: Controls what the recipient sees on the message. Hidden tracks the SLA without showing the recipient anything, for organisations that want to measure performance without applying time pressure. Due Time shows the deadline. Countdown shows the remaining time, colour coded as the deadline approaches.
fields.help: What the recipient sees. Hidden = track quietly: no countdown, no success badge, no snooze warnings. Due Time = show the deadline. Countdown = show time remaining, colour coded, ticking while they hover.

fields.name: ActOnIt__SLAClosureIsResponse__c
fields.label: SLA Closure Is A Response
fields.desc:
True when Closed is one of the events selected in Counts as a Response, meaning clearing the message legitimately stops the SLA clock.

Exists because Salesforce only permits multi-select picklist functions such as INCLUDES() on the same object. The SLA Outcome formula lives on Message Recipient and needs to know whether closing counts as a response, so the test is resolved here and read across the relationship as a plain checkbox.

Derived field - not intended for direct configuration. Change Counts as a Response instead.
fields.help: Derived: true when Closed is one of the selected response events, so clearing a message stops the clock. Exists because a formula cannot test a multi-select picklist on another object. Change Counts as a Response instead.

fields.name: ActOnIt__SLAGoldSeconds__c
fields.label: SLA Gold Threshold (Seconds)
fields.formula:
/* Canonical seconds value, so unit conversion lives in one place and the grade
   formula on Message Recipient stays a simple numeric comparison. */
IF( OR( ISBLANK( ActOnIt__SLAGoldValue__c ), ISBLANK( TEXT( ActOnIt__SLATargetUnits__c ) ) ), null,
    ActOnIt__SLAGoldValue__c * CASE( TEXT( ActOnIt__SLATargetUnits__c ),
        'Minutes', 60,
        'Hours',   3600,
        'Days',    86400,
        0 )
)
fields.desc: The value of SLA Gold Threshold converted to seconds. Derived field - the SLA Grade formula on Message Recipient reads this so the unit conversion is defined in exactly one place. Not intended for direct configuration.
fields.help: Derived: the Gold threshold converted to seconds, for the grade formula to compare against. Not intended for direct configuration - set SLA Gold Threshold instead.

fields.name: ActOnIt__IncludeParentFieldConditions__c
fields.label: Include Parent Field Conditions
fields.desc:
This setting should only be used for Objects with a high number of Notifications. 

To protect against governor limits Notifications are mostly evaluated asynchronously. A trigger will run initial checks to determine whether or not it is necessary to execute the Notification Processor. If 'Include Parent Field Conditions' is selected the trigger will include parent field conditions in it's synchronous evaluation, which will require more processing. Deselecting this field will ignore parent field conditions reducing the amount of processing (and SOQL queries) for the corresponding Object Trigger. Disabled = Faster Triggers but more asynchronous jobs against org limit. Enabled = (Potentially) Slower Triggers but fewer asynchronous jobs against org limit.
fields.help:
This setting should only be used for Objects with a high number of Notifications.

A trigger will run initial checks to determine whether or not it is necessary to execute the Notification Processor. If 'Include Parent Field Conditions' is disabled the trigger will ignore conditions referencing parent fields, reducing the amount of synchronous processing and SOQL queries required by the corresponding Object's Trigger.

For example: If set to '1', Notifications will only be executed when records are created or updated individually.
fields.help: This setting prevents the distribution of high volumes of messages during mass data activity. If the number of records created or updated exceeds this number, no messages will be sent.  For example: If set to '1', Notifications will only be executed when records are created or updated individually.

fields.name: ActOnIt__PathToAccountIdField__c
fields.label: Path to Account Id Field
fields.desc:
The path to the related Account Id field (Optional). If specified, this value is used by the application to link the underlying Act On It message to the related Account (via the Account__c lookup field).

For example, if you had a Custom Object called 'Booking__c' that triggered an alert message when it was created, the underlying message will automatically be linked to the Booking__c (via RecordId__c field). To ensure the message is ALSO linked to the Booking's parent Account (Venue__c), you'd simply set this field to 'Venue__c'. Act On It will then populate the Account__c field (on the underlying message) with the value in the Venue__c field for all Booking__c notifications.

Using SOQL syntax, you can traverse the hierarchal relationship to find the relevant Account field. e.g. 'Activity__r.Booking__r.Venue__c'

For example, if you had a Custom Object called 'Booking__c' that triggered an alert message when it was created, the underlying message will automatically be linked to the Booking__c (via RecordId__c field). To ensure the message is ALSO linked to the Booking's parent Contact field (LeadBooker__c), you'd simply set this field to 'LeadBooker__c'. Act On It will then populate the Contact__c field (on the underlying message) with the value in the LeadBooker__c field for all Booking__c notifications.

Using SOQL syntax, you can traverse the hierarchal relationship to find the relevant Contact field. e.g. 'Activity__r.Booking__r.LeadBooker__c'

fields.name: ActOnIt__PathToLeadIdField__c

For example, if you had a Custom Object called 'Booking__c' that triggered an alert message when it was created, the underlying message will automatically be linked to the Booking__c (via RecordId__c field). To ensure the message is ALSO linked to the Booking's parent Lead (SourceLead__c), you'd simply set this field to 'SourceLead__c'. Act On It will then populate the Lead__c field (on the underlying message) with the value in the SourceLead__c field for all Booking__c notifications.

Using SOQL syntax, you can traverse the hierarchal relationship to find the relevant Account field. e.g. 'Activity__r.Booking__r.SourceLead__c'

fields.name: ActOnIt__ExpiryDateTime__c
fields.label: Expiry Date Time
fields.formula:
/*Alert messages never expire in Test Drive Org*/

If( $Setup.ActOnIt__ActOnItSettings__c.ActOnIt__IsTestDrive__c,Now()+1,

If( ActOnIt__MessageType__r.ActOnIt__ExpiryValue__c = 0 ,now()+(60/24/60), 
CASE( ActOnIt__MessageType__r.ActOnIt__ExpiryUnits__c ,
"Seconds", CreatedDate + (ActOnIt__MessageType__r.ActOnIt__ExpiryValue__c/24/60/60) ,
"Minutes", CreatedDate + (ActOnIt__MessageType__r.ActOnIt__ExpiryValue__c/24/60),
"Hours", CreatedDate + (ActOnIt__MessageType__r.ActOnIt__ExpiryValue__c/24),
"Days", CreatedDate + ActOnIt__MessageType__r.ActOnIt__ExpiryValue__c,
"Weeks", CreatedDate + (ActOnIt__MessageType__r.ActOnIt__ExpiryValue__c*7)


,now()+(60/24/60))))

fields.name: Simple_Score__c
fields.label: Simple Score
fields.formula:
ROUND(
                    (
                        IF(TEXT(Is_Inventory_Affected__c)="Yes",3,0) +
                        IF(TEXT(Money_Collecting_Incorrect_Amounts__c)="Yes",10,0) +
                        IF(TEXT(Prevention_of_Saving_in_Key_Areas__c)="Yes",2,0) +
                        IF(TEXT(Incorrect_Data__c)="Yes",1,0) + 
                        IF(AND(TEXT(Suitable_Workaround_Available__c)="Yes",TEXT(End_Users_Affected__c)="No"),-1,0) +
                        IF(TEXT(Currently_in_Beta__c)="Yes",2,0) +
                        IF(Child_Cases__c>3,2,0) +
                        IF(Child_Cases__c>7,2,0) +

fields.name: Actual_Working_Minutes__c
fields.label: Actual Working Minutes
fields.desc: Business-hours minutes a case was actively worked: from First_Agent_Assigned_At__c to close, measured in the case's business hours (Case.BusinessHoursId), minus post-assignment time spent in Waiting on Customer / Waiting on Dev / Waiting on 3rd Party / Appointment Scheduled (Business_Waiting_Minutes__c). Maintained by the CaseActualWorkingMinutes Apex trigger; populated when the case is closed. Null until the case is both assigned to an agent and closed.

fields.name: Business_Waiting_Minutes__c
fields.label: Business Waiting Minutes
fields.desc: Accumulator: business-hours minutes the case spent in a not-working status (Waiting on Customer / Waiting on Dev / Waiting on 3rd Party / Appointment Scheduled) counted only from first agent assignment onward, measured in the case's business hours. Banked by the CaseActualWorkingMinutes Apex trigger each time the case leaves one of those statuses. Feeds Actual_Working_Minutes__c.

fields.name: Elapsed_Business_Minutes__c
fields.label: Elapsed Business Minutes
fields.desc: Total business-hours minutes from First_Agent_Assigned_At__c to close, measured in the case's business hours (Case.BusinessHoursId), before subtracting any waiting time. Actual_Working_Minutes__c = Elapsed_Business_Minutes__c - Business_Waiting_Minutes__c. Set by the CaseActualWorkingMinutes Apex trigger when the case is closed. Null until the case is both assigned to an agent and closed.

fields.name: Hour_Created__c
fields.label: Hour Created
fields.formula:
IF( OR(
ISBLANK( $User.Summertime_Start_Offset__c ),

CreatedDate< DATETIMEVALUE(DATE(YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)),MONTH($User.Summertime_Start_Date__c),DAY($User.Summertime_Start_Date__c))
-(WEEKDAY(DATE(YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)),MONTH($User.Summertime_Start_Date__c),DAY($User.Summertime_Start_Date__c)))-1)) + $User.Summertime_Start_Offset__c /24,

CreatedDate>=
DATETIMEVALUE(DATE(YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)),MONTH($User.Wintertime_Start_Date__c),DAY($User.Wintertime_Start_Date__c))
-(WEEKDAY(DATE(YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)),MONTH($User.Wintertime_Start_Date__c),DAY($User.Wintertime_Start_Date__c)))-1))+$User.Wintertime_Start_Offset__c/24

),

HOUR(TIMEVALUE(CreatedDate+$User.GMT_Offset__c /24))
+IF( AND($User.Southern_Hemisphere__c, NOT(ISBLANK( $User.Summertime_Start_Offset__c ))),1,0)
-IF(HOUR(TIMEVALUE(CreatedDate+ $User.GMT_Offset__c /24))
+IF( AND($User.Southern_Hemisphere__c, NOT(ISBLANK( $User.Summertime_Start_Offset__c ))),1,0)>23,24,0)

,
HOUR(TIMEVALUE(CreatedDate+(1+ $User.GMT_Offset__c )/24))
-IF( AND($User.Southern_Hemisphere__c, NOT(ISBLANK( $User.Summertime_Start_Offset__c ))),1,0)
-IF(HOUR(TIMEVALUE(CreatedDate+(1+ $User.GMT_Offset__c )/24))
-IF( AND($User.Southern_Hemisphere__c, NOT(ISBLANK( $User.Summertime_Start_Offset__c ))),1,0)>23,24,0)

)

fields.name: Created_During_Business_Hours__c
fields.label: Created During Business Hours
fields.formula:
AND(
    /* Check if the day is a weekday (Monday to Friday) */
    CASE(
        WEEKDAY(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)),
        1, 0,  /* Sunday */
        2, 1,  /* Monday */
        3, 1,  /* Tuesday */
        4, 1,  /* Wednesday */
        5, 1,  /* Thursday */
        6, 1,  /* Friday */
        7, 0,  /* Saturday */
        0
    ) = 1,
    /* Check if the time is between 8 AM and 5 PM MDT */
    AND(
        VALUE(MID(TEXT(CreatedDate - 7/24), 12, 2)) >= 8,
        VALUE(MID(TEXT(CreatedDate - 7/24), 12, 2)) < 17
    )
)

fields.name: UTC_Date__c
fields.label: UTC Date
fields.formula:
IF(
  AND(
    CreatedDate >= DATETIMEVALUE(
      TEXT(YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate))) & "-03-" &
      TEXT(15 - MOD(DATE(YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)), 3, 1) - DATE(1985, 6, 24), 7)) &
      " 02:00:00"
    ),
    CreatedDate < DATETIMEVALUE(
      TEXT(YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate))) & "-11-" &
      TEXT(8 - MOD(DATE(YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)), 11, 1) - DATE(1985, 6, 24), 7)) &
      " 02:00:00"
    )
  ),
  /* DST: UTC - 6 */
  CASE(
    MOD(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate - (6.0/24)) - DATE(1985,6,24), 7),
    0, "Monday", 1, "Tuesday", 2, "Wednesday",
    3, "Thursday", 4, "Friday", 5, "Saturday",
    6, "Sunday", "Unknown"
  ) & " " &
  TEXT(MOD(FLOOR((CreatedDate - (6.0/24) - DATETIMEVALUE("1900-01-01 00:00:00")) * 24), 24)),

  /* Standard: UTC - 7 */
  CASE(
    MOD(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate - (7.0/24)) - DATE(1985,6,24), 7),
    0, "Monday", 1, "Tuesday", 2, "Wednesday",
    3, "Thursday", 4, "Friday", 5, "Saturday",
    6, "Sunday", "Unknown"
  ) & " " &
  TEXT(MOD(FLOOR((CreatedDate - (7.0/24) - DATETIMEVALUE("1900-01-01 00:00:00")) * 24), 24))
)

fields.label: Workload Score
fields.formula:
IF(
  OR(
    TEXT(LeadSource) = "Marketing - Customer Referral",
    TEXT(Sub_Type__c) = "Additional Location",
    TEXT(StageName) = "Closed Won",
    TEXT(StageName) = "Closed Lost"
  ),
  0,

  /* SQL verified in last 14 days */
  IF(
    AND(
      SQL_Verification_Date__c >= TODAY() - 14,
      SQL_Verification_Date__c <= TODAY()
    ),
    20,
    0
  )
  +
  /* SQL verified in last 60 days */
  IF(
    AND(
      SQL_Verification_Date__c >= TODAY() - 60,
      SQL_Verification_Date__c <= TODAY()
    ),
    50,
    0
  )
  +
  /* Stage points: 20 for BDR Qualified, otherwise 10 */
  IF(
    TEXT(StageName) = "BDR Qualified",
    20,
    10
  )
)

fields.name: RDNACadence__Update_Expected_Execution_Date__c
fields.label: Update Expected Execution Date
fields.formula:
IF( AND( RDNACadence__Participant_Type__c = "Contact", ISBLANK(RDNACadence__Contact_Id__r.RDNACadence__EntranceCriteria_Matched_Date__c) = TRUE),
			RDNACadence__Contact_Id__r.RDNACadence__EntranceCriteria_Matched_Date__c + 
		(	RDNACadence__CadenceAction_ID__r.RDNACadence__Day__c +
 (RDNACadence__CadenceAction_ID__r.RDNACadence__Hour__c /24)) 			 
			,  
			
			IF(AND(RDNACadence__Participant_Type__c = "Lead",ISBLANK(RDNACadence__Lead_Id__r.RDNACadence__EntranceCriteria_Matched_Date__c)=TRUE),
						RDNACadence__Lead_Id__r.RDNACadence__EntranceCriteria_Matched_Date__c+
					(	RDNACadence__CadenceAction_ID__r.RDNACadence__Day__c + 
			   (RDNACadence__CadenceAction_ID__r.RDNACadence__Hour__c /24))
						,
			
			NOW()
		
		))

Unchecked - Rollup Helper will ignore all converted leads 
Checked - Rollup Helper will attempt to update converted leads (may or may not succeed depending this org's configurations)
The converted leads are identified by the "isConverted" system field.
Required settings:
1. The "Enable Set Audit Fields upon Record Creation and Update Records with Inactive Owners User Permissions" option is checked, found under Setup -> User Interface

However, disabling this setting does not guarantee that rollups will not process, as other conditions can necessitate that processing occurs. Some examples are if the source object is a knowledge article, or the source object has custom formula fields.
fields.help: Check this field to remove non-essential processing such as filtering out fields that don't need to be updated. Leave this unchecked to have rollups only process when a change is made to the source field and no fields used in the rollup were updated.

fields.label: Usage % of Limits
fields.help: Determines the percentage of package specific limit usage at which Rollup Helper should switch to asynchronous processing.  It is generally not recommended to lower this value below 60%, and the default is 90%.

fields.name: rh2__Usage_of_Row_Limits__c

fields.name: rh2__Usage_of_Shared_Limits__c

fields.name: rh2__runAsModifyingUserOnly__c

fields.desc: This checkbox will cause Rollup Helper to only process queued asynchronous requests for the user that initiated the asynchronous request. If there is a queue record for a user that is not the Modified By user then the queue record will not be processed until a scheduled class runs the queue record or the user associated with the queue record adds an item to the Rollup Helper queue.
fields.help: This checkbox will cause Rollup Helper to only process queued asynchronous requests for the user that initiated the asynchronous request.

fields.name: Summary__c
fields.label: Summary
fields.formula:
IF(
  ISPICKVAL(Log_Type__c, "Tier Change"),
  "Tier changed from " & BLANKVALUE(Previous_Tier__c, "(none)") & " to " & BLANKVALUE(New_Tier__c, "(none)")
    & IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Duration_in_Previous_Tier_Min__c)), Duration_in_Previous_Tier_Min__c > 0),
        " (" & TEXT(Duration_in_Previous_Tier_Min__c) & " min in previous tier)", ""),
  IF(
    Queue_to_User_Transfer__c,
    "Assigned from " & BLANKVALUE(Previous_Owner_Display__c, "queue") & " to " & BLANKVALUE(New_Owner_Display__c, "(unassigned)")
      & IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Duration_with_Previous_Owner__c)), Duration_with_Previous_Owner__c > 0),
          " (" & TEXT(Duration_with_Previous_Owner__c) & " min in queue)", ""),
    "Reassigned from " & BLANKVALUE(Previous_Owner_Display__c, "(unassigned)") & " to " & BLANKVALUE(New_Owner_Display__c, "(unassigned)")
      & IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Duration_with_Previous_Owner__c)), Duration_with_Previous_Owner__c > 0),
          " (" & TEXT(Duration_with_Previous_Owner__c) & " min with previous owner)", "")
  )
)
fields.desc: Plain-language one-line summary of the history entry so users can read what happened at a glance. Distinguishes a queue-to-agent assignment (with time waited in queue) from a reassignment between owners (with time the previous owner held it), and tier changes. Works for legacy rows with no Log Type by defaulting to the owner format.

fields.name: Average_Score__c
fields.label: Average Score
fields.formula:
IF(
  (IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_1__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_1__c)) = 0), 0, 1) +
   IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_2__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_2__c)) = 0), 0, 1) +
   IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_3__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_3__c)) = 0), 0, 1) +
   IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_4__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_4__c)) = 0), 0, 1) +
   IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_5__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_5__c)) = 0), 0, 1) +
   IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_6__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_6__c)) = 0), 0, 1) +
   IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_7__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_7__c)) = 0), 0, 1) +
   IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_8__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_8__c)) = 0), 0, 1) +
   IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_9__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_9__c)) = 0), 0, 1) +
   IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_10__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_10__c)) = 0), 0, 1)) = 0,
  0,
  (
    IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_1__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_1__c)) = 0), 0, VALUE(TEXT(Response_1__c))) +
    IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_2__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_2__c)) = 0), 0, VALUE(TEXT(Response_2__c))) +
    IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_3__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_3__c)) = 0), 0, VALUE(TEXT(Response_3__c))) +
    IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_4__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_4__c)) = 0), 0, VALUE(TEXT(Response_4__c))) +
    IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_5__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_5__c)) = 0), 0, VALUE(TEXT(Response_5__c))) +
    IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_6__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_6__c)) = 0), 0, VALUE(TEXT(Response_6__c))) +
    IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_7__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_7__c)) = 0), 0, VALUE(TEXT(Response_7__c))) +
    IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_8__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_8__c)) = 0), 0, VALUE(TEXT(Response_8__c))) +
    IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_9__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_9__c)) = 0), 0, VALUE(TEXT(Response_9__c))) +
    IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_10__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_10__c)) = 0), 0, VALUE(TEXT(Response_10__c)))
  ) /
  (
    IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_1__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_1__c)) = 0), 0, 1) +
    IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_2__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_2__c)) = 0), 0, 1) +
    IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_3__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_3__c)) = 0), 0, 1) +
    IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_4__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_4__c)) = 0), 0, 1) +
    IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_5__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_5__c)) = 0), 0, 1) +
    IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_6__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_6__c)) = 0), 0, 1) +
    IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_7__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_7__c)) = 0), 0, 1) +
    IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_8__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_8__c)) = 0), 0, 1) +
    IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_9__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_9__c)) = 0), 0, 1) +
    IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_10__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_10__c)) = 0), 0, 1)
  )
)
